id.meaning: The id path parameter, matched against routine_id or unit in program rows.

registration.meaning: The registration, or null when no matching registration exists. Existing rows include routine_id, enabled, registered_at, envelope and raw_envelope.

held.meaning: Whether the routine is held, when the registration table exists.

held_at.meaning: Hold timestamp, or null if not held; absent if the database or registration table is missing.

lines.meaning: Line rows include routine_id, line, value, state, observed_at and reason.

programs.meaning: Program rows include unit, scope, routine_id, desired, life, last_receipt, updated_at and the systemd cache observation.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists fixed literal outcomes. Open forms can also appear: <raw SQLite error text>, <stored-envelope JSON parser message>. On success the final receipt reports none.
